name: Follow a written instruction
short_description: Read and carry out one short written instruction in a language the reader uses.
self_assessment: I can follow one short written instruction without help.
description: Read and carry out one short written instruction in a language the reader uses. The stated threshold defines a repeatable capability that can be demonstrated in a fresh but ordinary context. It covers preparation, execution, and checking the result within the named conditions. It excludes a one-off task or dependence on a particular product, institution, culture, or living arrangement, so the holder can assess and retain it as a transferable skill.
examples: Follow a one-step direction on a sign
